caption: Figure 13.3: The five-rung adjoint memory ladder in AdjointSimulation(..., memory=...). Computing ∂J/∂(ieps_e) requires the forward increments q_e^n at step n. The four storage mechanisms trade memory footprint against recomputation: 'store' keeps the full N_t × N_design trace; 'checkpoint' stores K full-state snapshots and recomputes forward in B-step windows via the Revolve schedule; 'reverse' records only the CPML rim and time-reverses lossless interior dynamics; 'nyquist' subsamples every D-th step and linearly interpolates; 'auto' selects the fastest exact mode that fits within memory_budget_gb.
